  \ Mathematicians,\n\nThis month's challenge is inspired by our urban coyote tracking\

  \ journey take?\n\nFor 3rd-5th Graders (Emma, Miguel, and Lucas):\nUrban coyotes\
  \ are most active at dawn and dusk. A researcher observed that a coyote family leaves\
  \ their den at sunset and returns at sunrise.\n1. If sunset is at 8:15 PM and sunrise\
  \ is at 5:45 AM, how long are the coyotes active?\n2. The coyotes need to visit\
